articles.summary: They might appear to be a good alternative to OEM originals, but counterfeit or generic parts are often manufactured without adhering to the rigorous specifications and quality standards set by the original equipment manufacturer.Generic components often require more frequent servicing or replacement, eroding initial cost savings and increasing downtime.The use of non-original components can invalidate regional certifications or warranties, exposing crane owners to legal and financial risk, and workers to safety risks.
articles.title: Understanding the hidden risks of generic parts in crane maintenance

articles.summary: Dutch company Mick Volendam Groep used a four-axle Grove all-terrain crane to install a prefab home extension in the city of Alkmaar in just one day.The Grove GMK4100L-2’s compact footprint and long boom were ideal for the tight residential area.The crane is backed by Manitowoc’s comprehensive aftermarket support from the service facility in Breda.
articles.title: Grove GMK4100L-2 powers rapid one-day prefab installation in The Netherlands
